title: A declared name is one edit away from `composer/composer`
description: composer.json declares a declared package name in composer.json within one edit of `composer/composer`. Composer resolves these names against the configured repositories, so a name that only looks like the intended package installs foreign code. The name this rule expects is `composer/composer`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `composer/composer`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `composer/composer` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `composer/composer` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
